name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold mineral properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds interests in multiple properties including the Lazy Claims, Loman, and Agai-Pah properties in Mineral County, Nevada, the Swales Property in Elko County, Nevada, and the Belshazzar property in Boise County, Idaho. Operating with a low-overhead royalty and streaming business model, the company gains exposure to gold exploration upside without the capital costs of conventional mining operations.
